question: Campaign section 22 names the Samaveda as the case where 100% listening review may be required. What population was actually reviewed?
overstatement_guard: No listening sheet is produced and no row claims aural verification. A prior session in this project shipped a listening sheet whose decisive row quoted what a BROKEN mapping would play, which is what happens when a sheet is written from expectation. There is nothing to compare against here anyway: the Samavedic gana has no printed text this project holds in a form a listener could follow, and the only notation witness for 421 of the 657 units is a page scan.

what_was_verified_instead_and_how.method: sha256 computed over the fetched bytes; the sha1 of the same byte stream re-derived and compared to the sha1 MediaWiki reports. 475/475 agree, so the bytes hashed are provably the bytes Commons describes.
bytes received compared to the inventory's byte_size. 475/475 agree.

what_was_verified_instead_and_how.property: the file is really audio, and how long
what_was_verified_instead_and_how.method: the Ogg identification header and the final page granule position were read out of the container, giving a duration INDEPENDENT of the API's. 474/474 agree with the API-reported duration within 0.1 s. One file (Aurnayavottaram.ogg) puts its Vorbis identification header beyond the first 4 KB, so its rate was not read and its measured duration is recorded as null rather than assumed; its granulepos of 4,506,624 over 44,100 Hz reproduces the API's 102.191 s, but that is corroboration, not a measurement.
475 distinct sha256 values: no file is a byte-duplicate of another.

what_was_verified_instead_and_how.property: which gana the file belongs to
what_was_verified_instead_and_how.method: transclusion on a pinned sa.wikisource gana page. 468 files appear on exactly one page, 6 on two, 1 on four.
per-file imageinfo: 459 CC BY-SA 4.0, 16 CC0, 0 unstated.

honest_summary: Zero minutes of this corpus were heard. Every claim this artifact makes about the audio is a claim about bytes, containers, licences and source placement, and none is a claim about what the recording contains. A gana-to-audio mapping is asserted only at the granularity the source itself chose: one file, one gana page.
